requirements.general_text: Any one of these: SPM: Pass with minimum credits in 3 subjects, inclusive of Mathematics and a pass in English. Candidates with a credit in accounting-related subject(s) at the SPM level (or equivalent) may be given preferential consideration. UEC: Pass with minimum grade B in 3 subjects, inclusive of Mathematics and a pass in English. O-Level: Pass with minimum grade C in 3 subjects, inclusive of Mathematics and a pass in English. Certificate: Pass a certificate (Level 3 MQF) in any related field. STPM: Pass with minimum grade C (CGPA 2.0) in any subject, and a credit in Mathematics and a pass in English at the SPM level. Others: Recognized Malaysian qualifications or their equivalent. English Proficiency Requirements (International Students): MUET: 3.0 TOEFL: 550 IELTS: 5.5 or equivalent.
